# Build this week's staff schedule in a minute

> Free weekly staff schedule maker. List your people, roles, hour limits and days off plus the shifts to cover, and get a fair schedule that respects rest between shifts, with open shifts explained, a labor cost estimate and CSV and text exports. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
